windowNote: core = +30% within 14 days of report price (catalyst plays) · turbo = +50% within 30 days (moonshot plays) · MAE = max adverse excursion (worst drawdown before target hit, or over the window if never hit) · GUARDRAIL (2-tier, backlog #27): n < 5 in a bucket = context only, NEVER a reason to include/exclude/re-rank a pick. n >= 5 = MUST be applied — if that bucket's hitRate is clearly below the overall rate, picks of that type need visibly higher upside/conviction to make top 5, and screening output must say when this rule fired (or that no bucket met the n>=5+divergence bar). REGIME CAVEAT (both tiers): always read hitRate next to avgBenchmarkPct/regimeNote — a 0% hit-rate measured in a deeply negative SPY window means "unproven in a bad regime", not "this type doesn't work" (e.g. earnings_beat 0/12 measured during the Jul 2026 SOX selloff).

regime.note: SPY return over the same window as each complete entry (core+turbo combined). Pair with core.overall.regimeNote / core.byType[].regimeNote / turbo.overall.regimeNote before judging a hitRate — a low hitRate in a down-tape window is unproven, not disproven.

scenarioCalibration.note: optimismBias = written scenario % − realized max gain % over the same completed window. Positive = we write more optimistic scenarios than what actually happened.

core.note: Not perfectly apples-to-apples: near-miss uses point-in-time +14d price; picks use max gain within the 14d window (structurally favors picks). Treat edge as an upper bound, not exact.
